main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x drift-adjusted 24-bar return on the 24-bar grid, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with the supporting check passing); reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean drift-adjusted 24-bar return after the top fifth of positive raw values (rises)

decided_by: Reject rule: the main measure's t is at most -2, or the post-rise mean has a t of at most -2.
reading: The main mean is over all grid bars (forecast 0 bars contribute 0), the drift is the coin's mean grid 24-bar return over all windows, and the top fifth is the 80th percentile of the coin's positive raw values on the grid bars; the plan's below-200 'inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow.
